title: Approximability Landscape of Welfare Maximization within Fair Allocations
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical study in computer science and game theory regarding the fair allocation of indivisible goods. It focuses on the computational complexity and approximability of maximizing 'utilitarian social welfare' under 'fairness' constraints like envy-freeness (EF1, EFX). These terms are used in their technical economic/mathematical sense rather than as an evaluation of religion, faith, morals, or societal ethics.
